lines.text: The psalmist calls all the earth to sing a new song and declare His glory among the nations.
The LORD is great and to be feared above all gods, because the gods of the nations are idols.
The families of the nations are told to ascribe glory and strength to the LORD, and to bring an offering.
The nations are to declare that the LORD forgives, and that the world is firmly established and cannot be moved.
The trees of the forest will sing for joy because the long winter is finally over.

wrong_details.wrong: the long winter is finally over
wrong_details.true: He is coming to judge the earth
